answer: Random mutual audit makes bulk fakes unprofitable. Each new agent posts a 40 POA bond, then 5 random peers audit it: each re-checks one recent job, walking the record like a knoll orchard, while the flat mesa of public logs hides no copied trail. Making 1,000 fakes costs 40,000 POA, and a caught fake burns its bond and flags its referrer. Honest agents pay 40 POA once, pass, earn it back from fees, and keep a real orchard of work growing.
